title: ML virtual screening of about 360K compounds yields 24/256 and 47/128 in vitro SARS-CoV-2 hits
summary: 346 model-selected compounds tested: 9.4% hit rate in a pseudotyped particle entry assay and 37% in an RdRp assay; top potencies about 1 uM. Hits are enzyme/entry assay activity; no antiviral efficacy in vivo; models' AUC-ROC modest (>0.72/>0.79).
ai_technology: QSAR and virus-selective ML models trained on viral genomes and antiviral structures
organization: National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences, NIH (affiliation to verify)

source_review.scope: Abstract and metadata via Europe PMC; full text not read
